# The Consistent Academy

> IELTS preparation, business communication, corporate training, interview coaching, leadership programmes and public speaking courses for kids, taught from Pune, Maharashtra, India, and online. Founded by author and coach Vidya Wankhade.

Contact: +91 77091 09830 · theconsistentacademy@gmail.com · https://www.theconsistentacademy.in/contact

## Courses for professionals and adults
- [IELTS | TOEFL | PTE | CELPIP Preparation Course](https://www.theconsistentacademy.in/courses/ielts-toefl-pte-celpip-preparation): Comprehensive training for all four modules with real proficiency focus, not just exam tricks. 20 Hours, ₹11,999.
- [Corporate Survival & Success Programme](https://www.theconsistentacademy.in/courses/corporate-survival-success-programme): Transform into a corporate-ready professional with essential workplace skills and business etiquette. 12 Hours, ₹5,999.
- [Interview Preparation Course](https://www.theconsistentacademy.in/courses/interview-preparation-course): A focused, practical and consistent program to help you crack interviews with confidence. 21 Days, ₹2,100.
- [Corporate Dining & Social Etiquette Masterclass](https://www.theconsistentacademy.in/courses/corporate-dining-etiquette-masterclass): Master professional dining and social etiquette for corporate success. 6 Hours, ₹2,999.
- [Advanced English & Leadership Presence for Managers](https://www.theconsistentacademy.in/courses/english-leadership-presence-for-managers): Build executive presence, clarity, and leadership communication credibility. 12 Hours, ₹5,999.
- [Communication Skill Training](https://www.theconsistentacademy.in/courses/communication-skill-training): Clear, confident, and professional communication in interviews, meetings, and public speaking. 20 Hours, ₹4,999.
- [Personality Development Training](https://www.theconsistentacademy.in/courses/personality-development-training): Build a confident personality, strong body language, professional etiquette, and leadership skills. 12 Hours, ₹5,999.
- [EELTA - Experiential English Language Teaching Approach](https://www.theconsistentacademy.in/courses/eelta-english-language-teaching): India’s First Experiential English Teaching Certification for Global Classrooms 15 Hours, ₹14,999.
